contracts.solid: Foot-body clearance and swept navigation; running impacts recoil without crossing the solid.
contracts.soft: An explicit sensor, separate from solid geometry, drives damped contact motion. Frame posts remain solid.
contracts.wet: Rain exposure carries a short wet status indoors; spaced footprints fade and are pooled.
contracts.terrain: An owned equipped tool may change eligible owner-yard grass to durable soil. Shovel uses an explicit nearby action; mower uses accepted movement.
contracts.ambient: Fish stay inside water bounds, move without actor contact and freeze under reduced motion.
